test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 23 Sept, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language,

X + Y means ‘X is the sister of Y’,

X − Y means ‘X is the son of Y’,

X × Y means ‘X is the husband of Y’,

X ÷ Y means ‘X is the mother of Y’.

Based on the above, how is T related to X if ‘T + U − V × W ÷ X’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/47a89a5bb9daa01f32d67cf5151f1acc95989e845ae3c3eb86353e0d1da9cbdc.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Sister
 Son
 Husband
 Mother
 
 

 

Given: ‘T + U − V × W ÷ X

It means: T is the sister of U, U is the son of V, V is the husband of W and W is the mother of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03a5ab85d58ec3db19c06d2219c593afed396c60ba3bb510c08946591ff5c1c9.png] 

So, T is the '**Sister**' of X.

Hence, the correct answer is "Sister".
